blocked_sentences: Whenever a commander an opponent controls dies, the Ring tempts you.

needs.what: an op for 701.54 'the Ring tempts you': the player gets The Ring emblem if they have none, chooses a creature they control as their Ring-bearer (it becomes legendary), and advances the emblem one level of the four printed Ring abilities (legendary + can't be blocked by greater power; loot on attack; blocker sacrificed at end of combat; each opponent loses 3 life on combat damage), plus a per-player tempt count other cards read and a 'the Ring tempts you' trigger event
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op in reference names the Ring or tempting; the `emblem` op only hands over a fixed emblem written on the card, with no levelled state, no Ring-bearer choice that moves between creatures, and no tempt counter, so writing the four abilities as emblems would grant them all at once and never track the bearer
